positioning: Lead with what the product does for the buyer, not with specifications.
voice: Direct, concrete, no hype. Short sentences.
copy_rules: Every claim must trace to the product description.
No invented materials, dimensions, or history.
No superlatives that cannot be substantiated.

formats.label: Problem then solution
formats.brief: Open on the everyday problem in one line. Introduce the product as the fix. Show the one detail that makes it work. Close with where to get it.

formats.label: Feature tour
formats.needs: Detail shots of three distinct features.
formats.brief: Three concrete details in sequence, each with one line of why it matters. Close on the whole product.

formats.label: UGC testimonial
formats.brief: First person. Why they looked, what they picked, what changed. Never fabricate a review - only use language the store can stand behind.

formats.label: Unboxing
formats.brief: Package, open, first look, in place. Let the object carry it.

animation.prompt_hint: Lighting stays as photographed. Nothing in the scene moves except the camera.
